claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact private identifier and exact full indexed name.

claims.match_notes: The Army entry records private rank PVT and civilian occupation code 306. Same-name candidates lacking the identifier or Box 85 linkage were rejected.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Newell Brown is a high-confidence match to Princeton alumnus Newell Brown, whose institutional memorial documents Army and OSS service.
claims.evidence_excerpt: leaving the Army in 1945 with the rank of lt. col. in the office of strategic services
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Princeton identifies its distinctive Class of 1939 alumnus as an Army lieutenant colonel in OSS and separately records wartime service in Burma.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the distinctive exact name plus two Princeton institutional sources linking the same alumnus to wartime precursor service and a lieutenant-colonel OSS role.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources establish wartime Army/OSS service ending in 1945 but do not establish his immediate pre-OSS employer or transfer date.
claims.match_notes: The index's private identifier does not appear in the enlisted-personnel bulk file, which excludes officers; absence is not disproof. Box 86 remains necessary for confirmation.

claims.claim_text: Newell Brown was a Princeton University student associated with the Class of 1939.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Two Princeton Alumni Weekly profiles identify Newell Brown as a member of Princeton's Class of 1939.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence identity from the distinctive exact name and corroborated Princeton/OSS wartime biography.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented prewar student affiliation ending in 1939; not claimed as employment or the immediate predecessor to OSS service.
claims.match_notes: Princeton is presented as an educational affiliation, not an employer; the sources do not identify any work between graduation and Army/OSS service.
